_notes.source: Live https://audacity.capital/ pricing widget read in Chrome on 2026-10-20 with USD selected (Ability Challenge, Ability One and FTP tabs, all sizes), https://audacity.capital/affiliates-and-partners/ and Google Maps. Earlier sources (2026-10-11) listed in git history.
_notes.pricing: Prices in USD (USD selected; the site also offers GBP and EUR). standard = full (crossed-out) price, promo = discounted price shown in the pricing widget on 2026-10-20. Each program had its own code, so promo_code on the market is null and the codes are recorded here: Ability Challenge (2 steps) HALLOWEEN, 35% off ('No tricks - 35% off Ability 2 Steps'); Ability One and FTP: 14th, 14% off ('Celebrating 14 years'). The earlier 14% Ability Challenge prices are replaced by the 35% ones.
_notes.ftp_price_conflict: Settled 2026-10-20: the live FTP tab shows the $5K at $119 (promo $102), so $119 is correct; the 'From $199' comparison table was out of date.
_notes.ability_one_sizes: Live widget 2026-10-20 offers Ability One at $5K-$100K only (no $200K).
_notes.ability_challenge_limits: Limits differ by stage: Challenge (phase 1) 7.5% daily / 15% max loss; Verification and funded account 5% daily / 10% max loss. The table shows the phase 1 figures; the tagline explains the change. Both limits are static.
_notes.ftp_drawdown: The instant page says the 5% daily limit trails the balance as it grows, while the 10% max loss is fixed from the starting balance. Other parts of the same page describe FTP drawdown both as 'trailing' and as 'static', so drawdown_type records the max-loss rule and the tagline mentions the trailing daily limit. Minimum 5 trading days before a payout.
_notes.fee_refund: Ability Challenge: 'up to 100%' of the fee refunded with the first payout (homepage, 2-step page). Ability One: '100% Refundable' (funded-trader-program comparison table). FTP: no refund stated, so null.
_notes.profit_split: Ability Challenge and Ability One 'up to 90%'; FTP 'up to 80%' (one comparison table says 90% for instant; the instant page itself says 80% repeatedly, which is what is recorded).
_notes.company: Footer: trading activities run by AudaCity Global LTD (reg. 15850), licensed in the Union of Comoros (Anjouan). AudaCity International FZCO (Dubai Silicon Oasis) acts only as a payment facilitator; Propmetry Limited (Cyprus) is another payment partner. UK office: 25 Cabot Square, Level 11, London E14 4QZ. About page: started in March 2012; CEO Karim Yousfi.
_notes.vetting: Checked 2026-10-11 against our listing criteria. Trustpilot hides the score for a guideline breach and says fake reviews were removed (288 reviews). Of about 12 recent reviews read closely, 4 described a refused or voided payout after passing; the firm replied to some. Similar level to firms we already list, so it passed, but this is worth re-checking.
_notes.marketing_stats_excluded: Site claims such as '$250M paid out' and '500K+ traders' are not reproduced.
_notes.rule_units: Forex rules are % of account size.
_notes.null_means: Not stated on an official Audacity Capital page we could read.
_notes.affiliate_program: https://audacity.capital/affiliates-and-partners/ (2026-10-20): tiered - Silver 10% + 5% recurring (no target, exclusive discount code); Gold 15% + 5% recurring ($10,000 monthly referred revenue, affiliate manager, giveaways); Platinum 20% + 5% recurring ($25,000 monthly); Diamond VIP invite-only. Recurring commission on renewals and resets; sub-affiliate commission; tiers reviewed monthly. Monthly payouts 'via multiple international withdrawal methods' (methods not named). Cookie length: not stated. No country or comparison-site rules stated. Apply: https://trade.audacity.capital/user-auth/register (affiliate account sign-up).
_notes.google_rating: Google Maps (2026-10-20): 'Audacity Capital', financial institution, One Canada Square, Level 8, London - 3.8 from 160 reviews (recorded). Its website link is a Calendly page rather than audacity.capital, and the address differs from the footer's 25 Cabot Square, but it shares the phone number with a second listing 'AudaCity Capital' (The Frames, 1 Phipp St, London; 3.9 from 7 reviews). Worth a human check that this is the same company.

firm.name: Audacity Capital
firm.name_note: The firm writes its name as both 'Audacity Capital' and 'AudaCity Capital'.
firm.about: Audacity Capital says it began in 2012. It offers a 2-step challenge, a 1-step challenge and an instant-funded account on MT5 and DXtrade; it lists a London office, while trading accounts are run by a company licensed in the Comoros.
firm.hq: London, UK (office); trading entity registered in the Comoros

countries.notes: The site names Syria, Iran and North Korea but says the list is 'not limited to' them; no full list is published. US residents can only take part through the DXtrade platform, where permitted.

reviews.trustpilot_note: Trustpilot is not showing a score for this firm. Its page says this is because of a breach of Trustpilot's guidelines (288 reviews, checked 11 Oct 2026).
